integrity: The proof uses the induced five-vertex obstruction and an explicit Cartesian construction. Independent audit and external validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact majority C-chromatic number established only for ternary dimension three; for larger odd dimensions the proved quantity is a lower bound, not necessarily an equality. Independent historical-priority assessment remains outstanding.
title: Four majority colours in the ternary Hamming three-cube and a bound in every odd dimension
